You (or the model) bear full responsibi"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"lity for any motion command."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Feature overview"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**104** tools (`ur_*`) in total."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Category | Tool(s) (`ur_*`) | Description |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Connection | `ur_connect` / `ur_disconnect` | Connect / disconnect a UR robot by IP |

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Host compatibility"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The compatibility boundary lives in `package.json` → `peerDependencies`, and `npm run check:host:str"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ict` validates it against the **host's real schema DSL** — not just version numbers: it actually reg"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"isters all 104 tools into the host, drives the twin routes and checks the `dsh.client` declaration."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Stable releases**: `>=0.1.2-rc.1 <0.3.0` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `dsh-tools`), `>=4.0.2 <5.0.0` (`"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"cordis`), `>=3.18.2 <4.0.0` (`schemastery`) — any stable release in those ranges is covered without "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"touching the declaration.
- **Pre-releases**: semver only matches a pre-release when the range expli"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"citly names that same `major.minor.patch`. Each pre-release triple therefore needs its own clause (e"},{"id":"p16s5","text":".g. `>=0.2.2-alpha.2 <0.2.3`). When the host publishes a pre-release with a new patch number (say `0"},{"id":"p16s6","text":".2.3-alpha.1`), `check:host:strict` fails **and prints the exact clause to append**.
- **Historical "},{"id":"p16s7","text":"matrix**: `scripts/check-host-compat.mjs` pins a set of historical/current host versions and re-chec"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"ks on every run that the declaration still covers them — narrowing the range turns this red immediat"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ely, so adopting a new host can't silently drop an old one.
- **Old config and old data**: every cor"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"dis config field has a default, so a profile left with an older config (even just `pythonBin`) still"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" parses and takes the defaults; pose files carry their own `version`, the audit ledger is an append-"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"only NDJSON, and program files are plain `.urp` — none of them need a migration."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **`python/ur_worker.py`** — a persistent stdio JSON worker. It keeps `ROBOTS` / `ROBOT_MODELS` dic"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ts, connects by IP, and runs one command per call. Motion commands use (bounded) "arrival confirmati"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"on" polling and return a structured error on failure.
- **`lib/worker.js`** — lazily starts the work"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"er once and keeps it alive, matching line-delimited JSON requests/responses, with timeout and cancel"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" (forwards `exec.signal`).
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Notes / limitations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Connection persistence** — the worker process lives for the plugin's lifetime and keeps robot co"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nnections by IP; after a worker crash or a DSH restart you must `connect` again.
- **Remote control "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"mode** — some UR robots must be in "remote control" before they execute motion/program commands, and"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" `ur_connect` reports that state. **CB3 robots running URSoftware 3.1 through 3.20 already allow rem"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ote control by default**; a `remote_control: false` reading still means the controller is *currently"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"* not in remote mode — in local/teach-pendant mode URScript and motion commands are silently discard"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ed, so switch the pendant to remote control. Other firmware (e-Series, or CB3 outside that range) ne"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"eds Remote Control enabled in PolyScope first. An unreadable state is reported as unknown rather tha"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"n pretended to be `false`.
- **Reads you cannot trust are reported as such** — a state-setting comma"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"nd that has no read-back channel answers `verified: false`; a controller that refuses the RTDE sessi"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"on is reported as not running instead of "connected"; a twin frame that could not be refreshed is fl"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"agged `stale`.
- **Local file access** — `ur_upload_program` **reads** a local file and `ur_download"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"_program` **writes** one, so both are fenced to `programDir` (`<DSH_HOME>/nonead-ur/programs` by def"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"ault; change it with the `programDir` config). The **host** resolves the path after `realpath` (so a"},{"id":"p21s15","text":" junction/symlink cannot smuggle it out), checks `.urp` + `maxProgramBytes` (1 MiB), and only then i"},{"id":"p21s16","text":"njects the absolute `_local_path` / `_remote_path` into the worker payload; the model cannot set tho"},{"id":"p21s17","text":"se underscore-prefixed keys itself (`sanitizeArgs` drops anything not declared by the schema) and th"},{"id":"p21s18","text":"e worker refuses a `_local_path` that is not absolute. An empty `programDir` falls back to the defau"},{"id":"p21s19","text":"lt directory; a missing or unusable directory **fails closed** — nothing local is read or written. T"},{"id":"p21s20","text":"his is the same class of exposure as handing the model a shell, which is exactly why it is fenced ra"},{"id":"p21s21","text":"ther than trusted.
